tasks.title: Subnet Host Discovery (Ping/SYN Sweep)
tasks.description: Fast discovery across a CIDR block to find alive targets.
commands: nmap -v -sn {target_subnet} -oG scans/host_discovery.gnmap && grep Up scans/host_discovery.gnmap | cut -d ' ' -f 2 > scans/live_hosts.txt
sudo nmap -sS -v {target_subnet} -oG scans/syn_discovery.gnmap && grep open scans/syn_discovery.gnmap | cut -d ' ' -f 2 > scans/live_hosts.txt
